data.name: Bharanija
data.gender_notes: Bharanija is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bharanija is another name for Goddess Parvathy, the consort of Lord Shiva. It symbolizes strength, power, and divine grace. The name Bharanija carries the meaning “Goddess Parvathy's Name” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bharanija usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess parvathy's name and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine femininity and inner strength.
data.etymology: Bharanija belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Parvathy's Name.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bharanija total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

It is believed that invoking the name of this goddess would bring strength, courage, and protection in times of need. The name is deeply rooted in regional Indian traditions, particularly in regions such as Karnataka and Kerala, where the goddess is worshipped vigorously.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Bharanija" carries great spiritual significance, representing the divine feminine energy or Shakti in Hinduism. It is a reminder of the power of the universe and the presence of the divine in everyday life. The name is believed to hold immense spiritual power and is chanted to seek blessings, protection, and peace. It is a symbol of faith, devotion, and the recognition of the inner strength and power within oneself.
